name: Engine R3: effects for 2D layers and the stage (glow, drop shadow, outline, isolation)
description: Gives 2D layers the looks the Pixi filters gave, on Three: custom glow, drop shadow and outline effects for postprocessing, layer isolation (render one layer into its own target through the chain and show it on a plane), doc-level stage effects, and the effects-2d fixture.

userStories.title: GlowEffect: outer glow from the alpha around each pixel
userStories.description: As an author, I want a glow on a title or a cut-out so that it lifts off the background like the library's glow filter.
steps: Read engine/docs/05-effects.md ('Effect types' rows glow, dropShadow, outline and the paragraph on custom effects), node_modules/pixi-filters/lib/glow (shader source, read only) and the Effect class in node_modules/postprocessing/build/types/index.d.ts.

Create engine/src/effects/custom/glow.ts exporting class GlowEffect extends Effect with uniforms color, strength, distance (px) and texel size; the fragment shader samples the input alpha at 16 directions times 2 radii up to distance, builds a glow mask, and composites color x mask x strength behind the input (keeps the input pixel where alpha is 1).
Expose setters/getters for color (hex string), strength and distance, and update the texel size in setSize.
Create engine/src/effects/custom/glow.test.ts (construction in jsdom, uniforms, setters).
acceptanceCriteria: new GlowEffect({ color: '#ffd27a', strength: 2, distance: 10 }) has uniform strength 2, distance 10, and color equal to new THREE.Color('#ffd27a') (within 1e-6 per channel)
Setting color to '#000000' updates the uniform; getting color returns '#000000'
setSize(400, 200) sets the texel uniform to (1/400, 1/200)

userStories.title: DropShadowEffect and OutlineEffect2D
userStories.description: As an author, I want drop shadows and outlines on 2D layers so that text and cut-outs read on busy backgrounds.
steps: Read engine/docs/05-effects.md (dropShadow and outline rows), engine/src/effects/custom/glow.ts and node_modules/pixi-filters/lib/drop-shadow and outline shader sources (read only).

Create engine/src/effects/custom/dropShadow.ts (offset = distance in the direction of angle degrees, soft edge by averaging alpha over a disc of radius blur with 16 taps, colour x alpha composited behind the input) and engine/src/effects/custom/outline.ts (outline of thickness px from 16 alpha taps, colour x alpha behind the input), each with getters and setters for their params.
acceptanceCriteria: DropShadowEffect({ distance: 6, angle: 45 }) has an offset uniform of (6 cos 45°, -6 sin 45°) in pixels (y down in the doc becomes y up in UV) within 1e-6
Setting angle to 90 updates the offset uniform to (0, -6); alpha and color setters update their uniforms
OutlineEffect2D({ thickness: 3, color: '#ff0000' }) exposes thickness 3 and the red colour, and its setters update the uniforms

userStories.title: Register custom effects in the table; effectReach for padding
userStories.description: As a runtime author, I want glow, dropShadow and outline in the same effect table with tweenable params and a reach for padding so that isolation can size its target.
steps: Read engine/src/effects/table.ts (R1) and engine/docs/05-effects.md ('The effect table', 'Layer isolation' padding rule).
Add glow, dropShadow and outline to EFFECTS with scope '2d', the defaults of the table, and tweenables (colour kind for colours, deg for angle).
Add effectReach(spec) to engine/src/effects/table.ts: glow distance, dropShadow distance + blur, outline thickness, blur 32, others 0; and export padding(effects) = ceil(max reach).
acceptanceCriteria: EFFECTS.glow.scope is '2d' and every tweenable key of glow, dropShadow and outline round-trips through set and get
padding([{ type: 'glow', params: { distance: 10 } }, { type: 'dropShadow', params: { distance: 6, blur: 4 } }]) is 10; with blur present it is 32; with only vignette it is 0

userStories.title: isolateNode: render one layer through its effects into a target shown on a plane
userStories.description: As an author, I want effects on a single 2D layer that move, rotate and fade with it so that a glowing title behaves like the library's filtered sprite.
steps: Read engine/docs/05-effects.md section 'Layer isolation', engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md 'Base transform' and engine/src/effects/chain.ts (output target, test factory).

Create engine/src/effects/isolate.ts exporting isolateNode(node, effects, renderer) and IsolatedNode as specified: padding from padding(effects); a private Scene that receives the node's content group; an OrthographicCamera covering [-padding, width + padding] x [padding, -(height + padding)]; a WebGLRenderTarget of (width + 2 padding) x (height + 2 padding); a chain with output that target and toneMapping false; a plane with the target texture (configure2DMaterial, toneMapped false) added to node.display at the content offset minus padding; update renders only the chain; dispose releases target, plane and chain and puts the content back.
renderer null uses the chain test factory.
Create engine/src/effects/isolate.test.ts with a fake node (display and content groups, size 200x100) and a fake chain.
acceptanceCriteria: With a glow of distance 10 on a 200x100 node, the target is 220x120 and the camera has left -10, right 210, top 10, bottom -110
After isolateNode, the node's content is no longer a child of node.display and the plane is; after dispose the content is back under display and the plane is removed
update(1, 30) calls the fake chain's render once; resolveTarget('g', 'strength') returns the chain's ref
dispose() disposes the render target and the plane material (spied)

userStories.title: Stage effects and the effects-2d fixture
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want whole-frame effects and one fixture that uses every 2D-capable effect so that the lab page and e2e check them all.
steps: Create engine/src/effects/stage.ts exporting buildStageChain(renderer, stage, camera, effects, size) returning a chain with output null and toneMapping false, or null when no effect is enabled; test it in stage.test.ts with the chain test factory.

Create engine/fixtures/effects-2d.json (1920x1080, 30 fps, 6 s): a grid of image, text and shape layers, one per effect type of scope 'any' or '2d' (glow, dropShadow and outline on text), each with one tween on a tweenable param via effect:<id>, plus one doc-level effect (vignette).
Export the new API from engine/src/effects/index.ts; run the fixtures test (engine/fixtures/fixtures.test.ts) and validateTargets on the new fixture.
acceptanceCriteria: buildStageChain with effects [] or only disabled effects returns null; with a vignette it returns a chain built with output null and toneMapping false
effects-2d.json parses, validateTargets returns no errors, and it uses every effect type whose scope is 'any' or '2d' (checked by a test against EFFECT_SCOPES)
Every effect tween's to keys in effects-2d.json are tweenable for that effect type (checked by a test)

readFirst: node_modules/pixi-filters/lib/glow, drop-shadow and outline shader sources (read only, for the approach) and node_modules/postprocessing/build/types/index.d.ts (Effect base class)
metadata.standingRule: Engine PRD. Everything is offline and free: unit tests in vitest (jsdom project) and browser checks on the engine lab pages. The director app is not changed.
guardrails: Work offline. The only network use allowed is `npm install`. Tests never fetch; browser checks load assets from web/public.
Never commit, push, tag, publish to npm, deploy or change repository settings. autoCommit is off and the owner commits.

Read engine/docs/README.md and the spec doc the story names before writing code. The spec is the contract: if it is wrong or impossible, do the closest thing that works and explain the difference in notes.

Porting is allowed: read tmp/reacthub-pixitweenjs/src (a read-only copy of the library, inside this repo) and copy what engine/docs/port-map.md says. Never edit anything under tmp/. Every ported file starts with `// Ported from reacthub-pixitweenjs <path> (MIT).` and is cleaned up to strict TypeScript.
No `@ts-nocheck` and no `@ts-ignore` under engine/. `@ts-expect-error` only with a reason on the same line.

engine/ is Three.js + GSAP only: it must not import from web/, server/, shared/, `reacthub-pixitweenjs`, `pixi.js`, `pixi-filters`, `@pixi/*` or `@react-three/*`. Only the web stub files listed in metadata.sharedEdits may import engine/.

Do not touch the director app: nothing under server/, shared/, web/src/ (except the stub files under web/ listed in metadata.sharedEdits) or the existing e2e/ specs. Config files only as listed in metadata.sharedEdits.
Everything you build goes under engine/ (src/, fixtures/, lab/, e2e/, docs/). Edit only the files named in the story's steps and their tests, plus the small edits listed in metadata.sharedEdits.

Determinism: no Math.random, Date.now or performance.now in anything that affects pixels; no GSAP `overwrite`, no `immediateRender: true`, no infinite `repeat` (engine/docs/02-timeline.md, determinism rules).
jsdom has no 2D canvas context and no WebGL: unit-test pure logic and object construction; check drawing in the browser. Never weaken a test to make it pass.
Do not add a dependency the spec does not name (`postprocessing` and `@types/three` are already declared).

Debug output and screenshots go to debug/engine/ (gitignored). For a browser check use the dev server the owner runs on http://localhost:5173 (do not start another on a different port); if it is not running, run `npm run engine:e2e` instead.
Record only real results. Never invent measurements or test output.
Three.js only: the custom effects subclass postprocessing's Effect with their own GLSL. Reading pixi-filters shader files for ideas is fine; importing pixi-filters is not (lint enforces it).

ui: Verify in the browser: with the dev server on http://localhost:5173 (owner-run; else `npm run engine:e2e` once it exists), open the page named in the story, confirm the stated behaviour, save a screenshot to debug/engine/, and record what you saw in `notes`
